Rule.name: Emergency Identity - Setup
Rule.Description:
One-time setup for the "Emergency Identity Disable / Enable" quick link. Safe to run more than once.
1. Creates the identity attribute "emergencyDisable" (Emergency Disable, boolean, editable, no source - only the quick link workflow sets it). 2. Makes "inactive" (the identity's disabled status in LCM) calculated by the global rule "Emergency Identity - Inactive Attribute", replacing the plain HR Authoritative CSV mapping, so it follows emergencyDisable. 3. Adds the audit actions EmergencyIdentityDisable, EmergencyIdentityEnable and EmergencyIdentityDenied to the AuditConfig, so they can be picked in Advanced Analytics > Audit Search.
Run it from the IIQ console: rule "Emergency Identity - Setup" Run "HR CSV - Setup Identity Mappings" before it.
